title: Desperate Four-Player Predicament
next_chapter_hook: "In the instant Chen Ji was about to be defeated, the bloodline power sleeping within his body suddenly awakened—that power resonated with the fragment of the Tianji Record."

text.content: "In the Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly. The aged voice carried an unprecedented gravity: 'Chen Ji, the testament your father left behind back then, this old one shouldn't have told you so early. But since you touched the edge of the third page of the Tianji Record last night... What he said was—"When the chess game reaches its endgame, the chess player also becomes a chess piece."' Mo Xiansheng paused, 'Your father foresaw everything that would happen today. Including you standing here, including the opponent you are about to face.'"

dialogue.content: "Zhou Tianxing—that name was a forbidden existence within the Tianqing Sect."

text.content: "The next morning, the Arena Platform for the semifinals had been covered with layered formations. Before the morning mist had dispersed, the Martial Arena was already packed with people. Chen Ji stood on the east side of the arena, watching that figure slowly walk over—Zhou Tianxing, the sect's seed player, the number one expert of the Inner Sect. More critically, his backing was Elder Zhou Ming of the Five Elders. It was rumored that Zhou Ming had not hesitated to use a precious 'Condensing Yuan Elixir' to cultivate this junior."

dialogue.content: "Elder Zhou Ming of the Five Elders sat in the VIP seats, his gaze like lightning sweeping over Chen Ji, a contemptuous curve tugging at his lips. The old Sect Master Ling Yuan sat beside him, silently observing everything."

text.content: "Waste, you actually dare to come?" Zhou Tianxing stepped onto the Arena Platform, his blue robes billowing in the wind. His Foundation Building Late Stage cultivation was released without any restraint, forming an invisible pressure. A spirit sword floated beside him, faint golden runes flowing across its blade—the hallmark of a mid-grade spirit artifact. The surrounding disciples couldn't help but gasp. Such equipment was simply overwhelming destruction against a servant disciple."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji slowly lifted his head, his face still bearing that harmless smile: 'Senior Brother Zhou jokes. This junior merely came to broaden his horizons.' As he spoke, he quietly called out to Mo Xiansheng in his Mental Sea, 'Master, can you see three hours into the future?'"

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his voice carrying a rare weariness: 'Chen Ji, you consumed too much Heavenly Fate Value when you broke through to the third page last night... This old one can only vaguely see some fragments. Moreover, one person's appearance will completely blur the foresight.' Chen Ji's heart sank. He knew who that person was—his missing sister, Chen Nian."

dialogue.content: "Han Lie crossed his arms, coldly smiling: 'This waste truly doesn't know death. Actually daring to exchange moves with Senior Brother Zhou. I dare bet he won't last three moves.' Several disciples beside him chimed in, their gazes toward Chen Ji filled with mockery."

"Su Qingyao stood at the front of the crowd, her brow tightly furrowed. She had noticed Chen Ji's strange expression when he left the scripture pavilion last night. Now she saw his overly calm demeanor facing Zhou Tianxing—this calmness was too fake, fake enough to make her heart tremble. She unconsciously gripped her sword hilt tighter, murmuring softly: 'Chen Ji, what exactly are you hiding...'"

choice.prompt: "The match had already begun. Zhou Tianxing's released pressure made the air itself freeze. Facing this unprecedented crisis, Chen Ji had to make a choice—"

choices.description: "Ignoring the massive consumption of Heavenly Fate Value, forcibly activate the Tianji Record to predict the opponent's next move. Extremely high risk, but may obtain crucial information."
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate Value will drop below the danger threshold, potentially affecting all subsequent abilities"

text.content: "A flash of determination crossed Chen Ji's eyes. In the Mental Sea, the Tianji Record fragment suddenly illuminated. However, just as he was about to touch that layer of hazy foresight, Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned sharp: 'Do not! Someone is interfering with the Tianji Record's aura—it is Zhou Ming!' Chen Ji felt an intense pain in his mind. The Tianji Record's visions shattered into scattered stars across the sky, instead revealing the fact that he possessed special abilities."

choices.text: "Test moves with his body, observe calmly"
choices.description: "Do not rely on foresight abilities, respond using true combat instincts and observation skills. Train himself in life-and-death combat."
choices.visible_reward: "Accumulate combat experience, keep hidden trump cards"
choices.risk_hint: "Facing an opponent with a mid-grade spirit artifact, may be defeated in one strike"

text.content: "Chen Ji discarded all侥幸, his body surging backward while his gaze死死 locked onto every subtle movement of Zhou Tianxing. His reactions were impossibly fast—possessing only Qi Refining cultivation yet somehow able to dodge multiple attacks under Foundation Building Late Stage pressure. Below the arena, whispers began: 'This waste... doesn't seem so useless?'"

choices.description: "Use words to stimulate Zhou Tianxing, causing him to reveal flaws in anger. Use speech as a sword, attack the heart above all."
choices.risk_hint: "Zhou Tianxing may directly use killing moves"
choices.process_label: words as blades, strike dao heart

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji suddenly smiled. That smile carried three parts mockery and seven parts amusement: 'Senior Brother Zhou, I heard this sword of yours cost Elder Five three Condensing Yuan Elixirs? Tsk tsk, what a pity for such a fine sword, yet held by someone who only knows how to hide in the shadows of elders.' His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears, 'I wonder how much of this sword's power can it truly exert in your hands?'"

text.content: "Zhou Tianxing's expression instantly darkened, murder clearly visible in his eyes. 'You seek death!' He stopped testing, the spirit sword transforming into a golden stream of light. Sword energy swept across the arena, gouging a deep gash visible to the bone in the stone floor. Chen Ji's sleeve was cut off, blood seeping out, but he narrowly avoided the vitals. In the VIP seats, Elder Zhou Ming's eyes flickered with a sinister gleam."

dialogue.content: "Ling Yuan stroked his beard, glancing meaningfully at Zhou Ming: 'Elder Zhou, your grand-disciple's killing intent seems rather heavy. This is merely a sparring match. How did it come to this?' Zhou Ming smiled coldly: 'Old Sect Master worries too much. Tianxing merely wants to bring honor to the sect urgently. An accidental slip, that's all.' Their gazes clashed in the air, undercurrents surging."

choice.prompt: "Although Chen Ji avoided the fatal strike, his left arm had been cut by sword energy, blood dripping onto the arena floor. Zhou Tianxing pressed forward step by step, sword light like a net, keeping him tightly trapped. In this critical moment—"

choices.description: "Reveal a hidden precious talisman, temporarily holding back Zhou Tianxing's assault."
choices.risk_hint: "Will face more questioning and investigation afterward"

text.content: "A talisman glowing with pale blue light suddenly blazed from Chen Ji's sleeve—a mid-grade defensive talisman 'Mysterious Water Veil,' sufficient to block a Foundation Building cultivator's full-power strike. The talisman transformed into a curtain of water, completely deflecting Zhou Tianxing's sword energy. Below the arena, there was instant uproar: 'Where did this waste get a mid-grade talisman?!' A flash of understanding crossed Su Qingyao's beautiful eyes. She should have known—this man never fought a battle without preparation."

choices.description: "Regardless of personal safety, engage Zhou Tianxing in close combat using the most primitive methods. Trade flesh and blood for a slim chance of survival."
choices.risk_hint: "Extremely likely to die on the spot"

text.content: "A trace of madness flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He actually charged toward the sword blade—everyone thought he had gone mad. However, in the instant the sword tip was about to pierce his chest, his body twisted bizarrely, narrowly evading the vitals while slapping his palm onto Zhou Tianxing's sword-holding wrist. This palm carried no flashy techniques, only pure, all-or-nothing force. Zhou Tianxing felt his wrist go numb, the spirit sword nearly flying from his grip."

choices.description: "Publicly declare surrender, preserve combat strength. As long as the mountains remain, there will be firewood to burn."
choices.risk_hint: "May be held accountable by the sect for cowardice"

text.content: "Just as everyone thought Chen Ji would continue to endure, he suddenly raised both hands high: 'I admit—' Before the words finished, a fierce sword energy grazed past his throat, leaving a blood mark on the side of his neck. Zhou Tianxing's cold laugh rang out: 'Want to surrender? Elder Five said this battle has no retreat until death.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Murderous intent surged in his heart—this was meant to kill him."

dialogue.content: "Enough!" Su Qingyao could no longer hold back, standing up, 'Zhou Tianxing, is this a competition or an execution? Don't you know the Sect Competition rules? Stop at the appropriate point!' Zhou Tianxing hmphed coldly: 'Senior Sister Su, this is between me and this waste. It's none of your business.' Su Qingyao trembled with rage, yet was pulled back by a senior sister beside her: 'Qingyao, don't act rashly. Elder Five is watching...'"

text.content: "Chen Ji saw Su Qingyao stand up for him. A complex emotion surged in his heart. This woman, who had been investigating him all along, now stood on his side without hesitation. He suddenly remembered what Mo Xiansheng had said: 'When the chess game reaches its endgame, the chess player also becomes a chess piece.' Could Su Qingyao already have been woven into this grand net by fate? Just as he was distracted, Zhou Tianxing's sword had already reached his eyes—"

dialogue.content: "Han Lie watched below the arena with glee: 'This waste is finished! With Senior Brother Zhou's sword strike, he won't even have a whole corpse left!' The disciples around him chimed in, their mocking laughter rising and falling. However, just then, a faint voice sounded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea—Mo Xiansheng's voice, but no longer that aged tone, but an existence far more profound and ancient. 'Chen Ji... your bloodline... should awaken.'"

text.content: "A scalding stream of heat suddenly surged from the depths of Chen Ji's dantian, instantly flowing through his limbs and meridians. His eyes turned light gold in an instant. Something seemed to be awakening within his pupils. That was... bloodline power! Chen Ji himself didn't know such terrifying power slept within him. The spiritual energy above the arena suddenly became chaotic. An ancient pressure spread outward from Chen Ji as its center."

dialogue.content: "In the VIP seats, Ling Yuan's originally calm expression changed abruptly. He stood up suddenly: 'This is... impossible!' His voice carried undisguised shock for the first time. Elder Zhou Ming of the Five Elders also felt that pressure, his face turning ashen. Only a black-robed figure sitting in the corner, a meaningful smile curving his lips—it was the spy arranged by Ye Qing."

text.content: "Zhou Tianxing's sword stopped abruptly three inches from Chen Ji's throat. His face turned deathly pale, cold sweat beading on his forehead. That pressure... made him, a Foundation Building Late Stage cultivator, actually feel the helplessness of an ant gazing up at the heavens. 'Who... who are you?!' His voice trembled."

"Chen Ji slowly lifted his head. Those light-gold eyes stared directly at Zhou Tianxing. His voice remained calm, yet carried an unsettling pressure: 'Who am I?' He smiled lightly. That smile, in Zhou Tianxing's eyes, was more terrifying than any evil spirit, 'I am... someone you cannot afford to provoke.' The moment the words fell, the bloodline power within him produced a strange resonance with the Tianji Record fragment—that was the sound of fate's gears beginning to turn."

"At this very moment, Chen Ji finally understood the meaning of his father's testament—'When the chess game reaches its endgame, the chess player also becomes a chess piece.' The Tianji Record had chosen him, yet it was also weaving him step by step into a greater chess game. And now, this chess game had only just begun..."
